```lean
intro hfg
contrapose! hfg
assume hfg': f.mul g = 0
have hfg'' : (f.mul g).val = 0 := by rw [hfg']
rw [mul_val] at hfg''
have h1 : ∃ (k : ℤ) (h : k ≠ 0), (f.val * g.val) = k := by {
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkne⟩ := (f.val * g.val).non_zero_factor
  exact ⟨k, hk, hkne⟩
}
obtain ⟨k, hk, hkne⟩ := h1
have h2 : (f.val * g.val) = k := by rw [h1]
have h3 : k = 0 := by rw [hfg''] at h2; exact eq_of_mul_eq_zero_right (by rw [h2]; exact hk)
exact false.intro hkne h3
```
